title: Choose the visual world for ACME Pay
question: Three styles for the HR salary tool. Pick one to build on, or re-roll.

options.label: Thematic Atlas
options.lineage: national statistical atlases and Bertin's map semiology
options.thesis: Pay across countries read the way an atlas reads a continent: flat colour ramps, legend-first filters.
options.viewport: Side rail, legend-style filter bar, a country tile cartogram coloured by median pay, employee table below.
options.risk: Colour ramps must stay legible for colour-blind users; every tile also carries its number.

raised.raise: Edited rows restyle in place without breaking the table grid, so every change announces itself where it happened.
Salary changes never vanish: the previous value stays visible, struck through, in the record's history.
Size carries hierarchy on a fixed ramp: cartogram tiles scale by headcount, colour by pay.

options.label: Isotype Census
options.lineage: Otto Neurath's Vienna Method picture statistics
options.thesis: People counted as people: every pay band is a row of figures, one figure per 100 employees.
options.viewport: Top bar, KPI strip, pay bands drawn as pictogram rows by department, dense table beside.
options.risk: Pictograms get decorative fast; they must stay exact counts, not illustration.

options.label: Annual Plate Sheet
options.lineage: a design annual's plate section on near-white stock
options.thesis: One near-white sheet ruled in hairlines: one grotesque, mono labels, a single periwinkle mark for what needs attention.
options.viewport: Sticky mono token bar of active filters, hairline-ruled KPI row, box plots by country, table on the same sheet.
options.case: Fuses cleanly with a dense table and wins on calm clarity; loses on audience identification.
options.risk: So quiet it can read as unfinished if the hairlines and type scale are not exact.

options.label: Split-Flap Board
options.thesis: Employees as live rows on a departure board.
options.viewport: A black board of employee rows.
options.risk: A costume of a transit tool on an HR screen.
options.case: HR managers do not identify with a concourse; black board hurts long sessions.
options.kept: Rows restyle in place on change without breaking the grid.

options.label: Ticket Wallet
options.thesis: Each salary change as a stamped coupon.
options.risk: Travel metaphor muddies a pay tool.
options.case: Strong on audit history, weak on scanning 10,000 rows.
options.kept: Nothing disappears, it cancels: salary history stays visible.

options.label: Star Atlas
options.thesis: Salaries as stars sized by magnitude.
options.case: Dark ground and mythic layer fight a daily data tool.
options.kept: Size carries hierarchy on a fixed ramp.

options.label: Garden Guide Map
options.case: Organic lobes cannot hold a sortable table.
options.kept: Colour owns whole regions, not scattered accents.

options.label: Event Circle Catalog
options.thesis: Employees as stamp-sized cells in a hall grid.
options.viewport: A packed grid of employee cells.
options.risk: Thumbnail grid has no real images to carry.
options.case: No pictures exist to fill the cells; table wins.
options.kept: The grid repacks in whole cells on narrow screens.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean blue data-dense HR dashboard, executed impeccably.
materials: Fira Sans with Fira Code figures
canonCard.viewport: Sidebar, KPI cards, bar chart and table, the arrangement any HR SaaS ships.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every admin template by design.
